title: Millennium Falcon (Star Wars)
intro: The Millennium Falcon is Han Solo's fictional light freighter from the Star Wars films, a modified YT-1300 with quad laser turrets and a hyperdrive that does not always work. Its four-seat cockpit sits on the right side of the round hull: the pilot in front on the left, the co-pilot in front on the right, switch banks overhead and the hyperdrive levers between them.

areas.name: Forward instrument panel
areas.text: Screens and gauges under the cockpit windows.

panels.name: Forward instrument panel
panels.text: Screens and controls under the windows: the jump calculations, the sensors and the shields.
panels.context: The crew watches them before a jump to hyperspace and during a chase.

controls.name: Navicomputer readouts
controls.text: These readouts show the jump coordinates that the ship's navigation computer works out before a jump to hyperspace (faster-than-light travel).
controls.context: The ship can only jump safely after the calculation is done; in the films this takes nervous seconds during escapes.

controls.name: Sensor screen
controls.text: This screen shows chasing ships and obstacles around the Falcon.
controls.context: It helps the pilot during chases, for example through an asteroid field.

controls.name: Deflector shield controls
controls.text: Controls for the deflector shields, the invisible protective field around the ship. They can angle the shield towards the danger.
controls.context: In the films the captain orders the shields angled when enemies attack from one side.

panels.name: Co-pilot station
panels.text: The front right seat with its own flight controls and switches.
panels.context: The co-pilot helps fly and runs the system and hyperdrive checks.

controls.name: Co-pilot yoke
controls.text: A second set of flight controls, so the co-pilot can fly the ship too.
controls.context: In the films Chewbacca sits here and takes the controls when needed.

controls.name: Co-pilot switches
controls.text: Switches for the ship's systems and for the hyperdrive checks.
controls.context: The co-pilot works them while the pilot flies, for example before a jump.

areas.name: Centre console
areas.text: The console between pilot and co-pilot.

panels.name: Centre console
panels.text: The console between the two front seats with the hyperdrive levers, the engine levers and switches.
panels.context: Both front crew can reach it; the jump to lightspeed is started here.

controls.name: Hyperdrive levers
controls.text: Pushing these levers forward together starts the jump to lightspeed, faster-than-light travel through hyperspace.
controls.context: The stars stretch into lines as the ship jumps. In The Empire Strikes Back the hyperdrive fails when the pilot pushes the levers, a famous scene.

controls.name: Sublight controls
controls.text: Thrust levers for the normal (sublight) engines, the engines used for flying below the speed of light.
controls.context: The crew sets them for normal flight; the hyperdrive levers are only for the jump.

controls.name: Switch rows
controls.text: Rows of toggle switches on the centre console, used before take-off and before jumps.
controls.context: The films show the crew flipping them quickly; each switch is not named.

areas.name: Overhead switch panels
areas.text: Banks of switches above the seats.

panels.name: Overhead switch panels
panels.text: Banks of switches and lights above the front seats.
panels.context: The crew reaches up to them in the start-up and before a jump.

controls.name: Overhead switches
controls.text: Many switches above the seats, flipped during the start-up and the routine before a jump.
controls.context: The films show them as part of the busy, worn cockpit; what each switch does is not explained.

controls.name: Status lights
controls.text: Lights above the seats that show the state of the systems.
controls.context: Together with the switches they make up the overhead panels.

areas.name: Quad laser turrets
areas.text: The gunner positions above and below the hull, reached by a ladder.

panels.name: Quad laser turrets
panels.text: Two gun positions, one on top and one under the hull, each with a four-barrel laser gun.
panels.context: In A New Hope Luke and Han fight off TIE fighters from these turrets while escaping the Death Star.

controls.name: Gun grips
controls.text: Two-handed grips that swing the whole turret around to aim.
controls.context: The gunner sits inside the turret and turns with it.

controls.name: Fire triggers
controls.text: Triggers on the grips fire the four laser barrels of the turret.
controls.context: The turrets defend the ship while the pilot flies.

controls.name: Targeting screen
controls.text: A crosshair display that helps the gunner aim at fast fighters.
controls.context: It shows the target as it crosses the gunner's view.

areas.name: Control yoke
areas.text: The hand controls the pilot flies with.

panels.name: Control yoke
panels.text: The yoke in front of the pilot's seat, front left.
panels.context: The pilot steers the freighter with it.

controls.name: Control yoke
controls.text: Pushing the yoke forward or pulling it back tips the nose down or up; turning it rolls and banks the ship.
controls.context: The pilot in the front left seat flies with it; the co-pilot has a second yoke.
